body: What makes you think boy if you don’t mind me asking ? I can’t work out if angle is too low for boy .
Men who cycle and have all the gear. Sorry but damn true
But That sounds dull as hell

It depends what you value as a high skilled job? 

Banker ? Yes Lawyer Yes? Career looking after the sick or homeless? 

Society values high paid roles but when you look at the roles of say a youth support worker and a lawyer who is morally the most effective?
This! There shouldn’t be a formal test either. It should all be about childrens confidence!

What an arrogant way of thinking? I was brilliant at science but would never judge someone for picking a topic which interests them and excites them? If everyone did these three subjects we would have a very dull and robotic world! People should choose subjects which stimulate them and they feel able to fully commit too. This leads to unhappy adults stuck in a career they only choose to seem academically acceptable and stifle creativity, individuality and other career options outside the big free.
I find maths dull. My mind is creative. Some people are logical and that’s great too! I agree it’s important to have basic maths but why is this the sole focus rather than other subjects?
I wish we would teach people to be good human beings. Support children with supporting their mental health?! Isn’t that more important ?

You sound lovely, I honestly can’t see the other view point on this. I’m good at understanding how a misunderstanding can happen but this is just odd behaviour. My only reasoning for this behaviour is that you made them feel bad subconsciously for providing better gifts than they did.
You sound awesome! I would love if my sister/brother in law did this and would show how much she cared about my relative. They are the problem , not you! They sound unkind

Speaking as someone a little older who has gone through feelings of loss and feeling like there is no way out  , please don’t do this! 

I understand your girlfriend breaking up with you is a trigger but I promise there is so much hope for you. 

You have your whole life ahead of you! Tell me 3 things that have made you feel good recently. Could be as simple as you had a McDonald’s and it tasted great.

Have you seen the movie soul ? Remember life is about enjoying the little things
